verdict.rationale: Docs show a generic 'update' operation (CLI/API can update or delete a memory) and note that new conversations get facts extracted and stored, implying some form of memory maintenance, but nothing in the pack explicitly describes automatic detection of contradicting information or merging/superseding logic. missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic contradiction detection, conflict-resolution rules, or memory-merging behavior when new facts conflict with stored ones, and independent verification that this works reliably.
